source_review.scope: Full local highlight core plus21 eager grammars, imported all-language/terminal/native graph bounded.

bounded_support_excerpts.claim: Compiled terminal registers eager grammar factories on same core singleton; bounded excerpt only.
Compiled renderer reads result.value, does not render errorRaised or illegalBy.msg.
Actual terminal code renderer validates language, ignores illegals, catches thrown error to raw input lines.
Optional all-language lazy import rejection suppressed by resolving; imported registration console errors independently possible.
All-language registry invokes same eager typescript factory; other grammar bodies pending separate assigned unit.

limits: Compiled highlight.js10.7.3 core plus21 eager grammar factories. Module exports CommonJS factory initializers; terminal-theme calls require_core and registers eager grammars, lib lazy registers the all-language set. Optional compiled consumers and direct exported factories/API only; ordinary Jouzu unbundled dot entry is distinct.

Own errors are direct library API throw/rethrow or returned illegalBy.msg/errorRaised metadata. error helper uses console.error; warn/deprecated use console.log, Vue uses console.warn. Compiled highlightCode checks supportsLanguage, uses ignoreIllegals true and only result.value, catches thrown errors to raw code; no automatic painting of diagnostic metadata. Direct API/custom grammar/DOM/Vue/debug paths separately qualified.

Exact raw templates/fragments retained without evaluation. Grammar keywords/names/aliases/patterns/CSS class names/HTML/code/API/event/version/URL/protected selectors remain technical values; dynamic source code/DOM/plugin/error/native reasons externally owned.
